items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was working for Teo Macero at Columbia.

ctx.x: Well, you signed with Columbia and then went to Atlantic.
I was working for Teo Macero at Columbia. He kept wanting me to... When they asked for “Rudolph The Red-Nosed Reindeer”... I left Columbia after that.
I see. They wanted you to do a super-commercial...
